recommendation: Keep the source clarification. No further MedicationKnowledge source edit is needed for this seed; any remaining enforcement belongs in build/tooling code if not already covered.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking to clarify UML interface rules after MedicationKnowledge.author and MedicationKnowledge.status were found incompatible with matching MetadataResource/CanonicalResource interface elements, with tooling/resource follow-up expected.
initial_application: FHIR-I minutes recorded agreement that the cases were not allowed and proposed UML text plus tooling. The FHIR-45284-tagged source commit cf075e642a119e94c55a933a60ec88ac86aa8031 added the MetadataResource template marker to MedicationKnowledge but did not change source/uml.html; FHIR-45285 later corrected the MedicationKnowledge element definitions.
additional_context: The combined branch already contains related decisions for FHIR-45285 and FHIR-32801, and MedicationKnowledge now templates/base-defines MetadataResource with interface-compatible author and status definitions. The remaining current-spec gap was that the UML page only had a generic redeclaration consistency sentence and did not explicitly address the same-name ambiguity raised by FHIR-45284.
reconciliation: Changed source/uml.html to state that elements with the same name as an interface attribute or association are redeclarations of that interface element, not independent elements, and must be consistent in type, binding, cardinality, and intended meaning while allowing narrower value domains.
source_changes: source/uml.html: clarified same-name interface attribute/association redeclarations and compatibility requirements.

related_jiras.note: Pharmacy issue filed from the FHIR-I discussion corrected MedicationKnowledge.name, status, and author for interface compatibility.
